info.description: Contract-driven collection for PayProof 2.0 (docs/api-contract.md, E01-E24 + pending E25-E28). Run folders in order 00-08. Tests double as contract-drift detectors: a failing assertion means live behaviour differs from the frozen contract - log it, do not silently edit the test. Manual step: pay the checkout URL (console) in the Monnify sandbox between E12 and E14/E15.
